messages.subject: gvisMotionChart is not working after deploying the app (no error messages)
parts:
Hi all, 

I'm trying to create an app using the gvisMotionChart function in googleVis 0.5.6 package. 

Things are working as expected while running the app locally but after deploying the app the Motion chart is not displayed. And I'm not receiving an error message of any kind. 
Does anyone faced this situation before?

Thank in advance

https://gedemced.shinyapps.io/GoogleVis_COMPOSICION/
